label: b1-recoverable-s1-dark
note: B1 arm sample 1 (fastboot boot, true POR). USER-CONFIRMED BLACK, and power key CANNOT control backlight => B-type subtype (same as baseline s4/s6). B1's mechanism PARTIALLY WORKED, which is the key finding: dmesg shows 'dsi: bonded command failure 1/3 (command DMA timeout), will retry' then '2/3 (panel not prepared), will retry' and NEVER 'giving up' => the permanent latch did NOT engage (part (a) works as designed). BUT there was NO SECOND ATTEMPT: 'Failed to initialize panel -110' occurs exactly ONCE, a single 'sending dcs data ff 20 failed: -110', and the panel prepare is never re-run. DRM instead gave up by itself: 192x 'hw recovery is not complete for ctl:1' + 'ctl 1 reset failure -22' + frame-done/vblank timeouts. => DIAGNOSIS: making the failure non-fatal is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT - nothing actually requests the retry. The missing piece is a caller that re-runs the modeset/panel-prepare (方案 B3 territory). l1=6, l2=444, dsi_isr=0, backlight=160, card0-DSI-1 connected, session up (false-GOOD trap again).
